content: DS2 SL1 Champion runs require all 41 bosses to be defeated with screenshots/videos showing **stats, inventory screen, and boss drops/empty arenas.**
If you used any boss souls for items, show them as well for proof. It is strongly recommended to not use boss souls just for souls, as you are effectively destroying your own proof.
**Proof example:** SL1 Champion of Dark Souls II proof example, by stepnfree.
DS2 SL1 Legend runs require adding **one** of the extra restrictions below onto the base DS2 SL1 Champion run.
For proof, submissions need video of all fights showing **stats and equipment** after killing the boss. It is recommended to also show souls obtained, especially for higher NG kills.

**CoC** = Company of Champions covenant, required for most Legend runs. Note that fighting Darklurker will require you to join Pilgrims of Dark covenant, so rejoin CoC afterwards (or use Cheat Engine to fight Darklurker in CoC if you’re on PC and you’re cool).

content: DS2 SL1 Master runs are equivalent to adding **two** of the extra restrictions from the Legend list onto the base DS2 SL1 Champion run.
For proof, submissions need video of all fights showing **stats and equipment** after killing the boss. It is recommended to also show souls obtained, especially for higher NG kills.

content: DS2 SL1 Grand Master runs is the highest recognised challenge in Onebros, it is by no means the hardest challenge however after discussion we've decided to pull the brakes here and leave it to the runners to push it even further. The required bosses remains the same. For proof, submissions need video of all fights showing **stats and equipment** after killing the boss. It is recommended to also show souls obtained.

restrictions.title: Legend And Above Banned Equipment and Strategies

groups.title: Allowed
items: Cheesing **Gank Squad/Royal Rat Authority** via stalagmite/Lingering Flame is allowed.
**Lifegems and Mushrooms** vs. both Smelter Demons are allowed as sources of healing for their aura damage.

items.text: **Burnt Ivory King’s gauntlet** is not considered part of his boss fight, so using Loyce Knights, healing, or whatever else you may want to complete it is allowed. Using Cheat Engine to cut out the gauntlet altogether is also allowed (but make sure you are using the modengine component so the ice spawns, otherwise you may have to redo the kill).
items: If you do use Loyce Knights, you must wait for Burnt Ivory King to kill the last Loyce Knight before engaging with him.
You do not have to include the gauntlet in recordings, but make sure to start the recording before Ivory King spawns.

groups.title: Banned
items: **Brightbugs** are banned in runs unless specified otherwise. They’re too strong.
**Red Tearstone Ring** is only banned in Legend runs.
Skipping **Fume Knight's Phase 1** with Velstadt's Helm is banned. Runs need to show that players can deal with all parts of a boss' moveset, cutting out a part of that moveset via item is not valid.
